# Feats #340 evidence and isolated preview

The 100 candidate YAML files under `pf1-content/src/pf-feats/` are byte-for-byte copies from pf1-content 11.4.0 at `02f4ab0d92e0d64f9eb2d127f42fd809cb23db7d`. `provenance.json` preserves the exact ticket-order inventory, source paths, byte hashes and raw description hashes. Reduced manifests configure a fixture import; they do not claim complete-checkout provenance. The tracked `pf1/packs/.gitkeep` retains the intentionally empty system pack directory.

`preview.json` contains exactly the 100 normalized candidate bodies from a preview of both complete pinned checkouts using the checked Curation Overlay. It preserves complete-source prerequisite identities that reduced fixtures cannot independently resolve. Tests compare reduced-import description, Modifier and Note values; they never fabricate missing dependencies.

The three raw files under `supporting-sources/` are pinned comparison evidence for ordinary Alertness (+2/+4 Perception and Sense Motive) and Dodge (+1 dodge AC), and Aspect of the Beast (Predator's Leap grants running-jump treatment without a numeric bonus). They stay outside the importer packs and do not expand the batch scope. Tests use those baseline amounts when checking mythic incremental bonuses.

Skill Focus (Knowledge [Local]) has +3 and +6 alternatives selected by exact rank Situations. The raw `ifelse(gte(@skills.klo.rank,10),6,3)` remains unsupported: automatic rank dispatch is an outstanding calculation. Conditional alternatives require their recorded circumstances.

The saved-sheet adapter omits the unusable imported `repeatable: "unreviewed"` sentinel without inventing repeatability. Isolated in-memory tests include prepared Skill Focus plus separately identified held Horse Whisperer as a behavioral fixture. They do not publish a release, approve held attribution, seed a remote deployment, or activate production sheet authority.
